title: Zephyr: encrypt + decrypt
notes:
Partial validation 2026-08-27: isolated Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 build succeeded (EDHOC disabled; only upstream warning promotions relaxed) and runtime passed 36/36 ZTESTs: RFC 8613 C.4/C.5 request protection, C.7/C.8 response modes, request/response roundtrips, exact ciphertext/options, tamper/auth failures, 40-bit PIV/exhaustion, replay/correlation, NVM rollback, buffer/output atomicity, malformed options/plaintexts. Audit confirms nonce/AAD staging, strict context/KID binding, replay commit after authentication+validation, sequence persistence before publication, and crypto_wipe of keys/nonces/plaintext/options. BLOCKER: shared RFC 8613 C.6 request-protection vector is not executable because oscore_ctx_create() has no public ID Context parameter/API (ctx id_context remains zero length); implementing that belongs to project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.6.7.7. Linked dependency; do not close until C.3/C.6 pass.
Final validation after blocker 6.7.7 closed: the same bounded qemu_x86 run now passes 38/38, adding exact RFC8613 C.6 ID Context request encryption/decryption and present-empty/bounds/context-binding tests to the prior 36/36 protect/unprotect coverage. Python shared-vector suite remains 38 passed; Rust lichen-oscore vectors remain 13 passed. Incremental Zephyr rebuild and scoped git diff --check passed; no additional changes were required for this bead.
close_reason: Full Zephyr OSCORE encrypt/decrypt acceptance passes, including ID Context
